page.overview:
What is Chansey?

Chansey is a round, pink Pokémon. It has stubby arms and legs with no visible digits. It has small black eyes and a mouth with no visible nose. It has three long frills on each side of its head. It also has a short tail and a pouch with a white egg. Its feet, pouch, and the ends of its frills are a darker shade of pink.

Chansey is an extremely brave and kind Pokémon and it always smiles, regardless of its mood. It is known to bring anyone happiness.

Chansey can either have the ability Natural Cure or the ability Serene Grace. Natural Cure causes all of Chansey's status effects to be cured when Chansey is switched out. Serene Grace doubles the chances that secondary effects happen. Chansey are supposed to bring happiness and are seen carrying a stone shaped egg and shares her with injured Pokémon. The Chansey line happens to have more items associated with it than any other Pokémon: the Lucky Punch, the Lucky Incense, the Lucky Egg, and the aforementioned Oval Stone.

Chansey evolves from Happiny if leveled up while holding an Oval Stone during the day and evolves into Blissey if leveled up with high friendship.
